audit.venue: Communications on Pure and Applied Mathematics
audit.summary: Critical O(1) Tracy-Widom argument uses the wrong size conversion; precritical moment prefactor is incompatible with the stated free-energy formula; printed refined RH construction has an uncancelled O(1/n) local pole. The last is a proof-construction defect, not a disproof of the unchanged scalar free-energy coefficient.
limitations: M25-0419-P1 — Counterevidence: If N in standalone(6.9) is consistently the LUE dimension, that display can be valid; conversion is still required before the same N is used as GinUE size in(1.20)/(2.17).
M25-0419-P1 — Counterevidence: c=1 or s=0 masks the discrepancy; neither settles all c,s. Unscaled eigenvalues/density normalization do not change exact duality dimensions.
M25-0419-P1 — Counterevidence: Radial baseline agrees to O(1); O(n^-1) radial terms cannot remove an O(1) discrepancy.
M25-0419-P1 — Counterevidence: Tail check(2.22) grouped with this issue: actual logF_TW(c^-2/3*s)=log2/24+zeta'(-1)-log|s|/8+logc/12-|s|^3/(12c^2)+O(|s|^-3) at fixedc.
M25-0419-P2 — Counterevidence: Actual source images5,7,10,15 inspected to fix the cubic, branch, exponent24, and denominator; not OCR inference.
M25-0419-P2 — Counterevidence: The exact identity and cancellation eliminate a missing universal GinUE normalization as an explanation.
M25-0419-P2 — Counterevidence: This proves internal incompatibility of the two stated main asymptotics; it is not an independent derivation of the full actual nonradial moment limit.
M25-0419-P3 — Counterevidence: Changing a common square-root or gamma branch cannot correct only off-diagonals while preserving matching diagonal h11 and all h12.
M25-0419-P3 — Counterevidence: The general n*[z^-1]R11=-q^2*(1-a^4*q^4)^2/[16*a*(1-q^2)*(1-a^4*q^6)^2] is exactly correct; sample=-25/1323.
M25-0419-P3 — Counterevidence: At infinity the first coefficient is h11+h21; off-diagonal correction leaves its diagonal unchanged, and R2Q/QR2 cross products begin at z^-2.

M25-0419-P3 — Counterevidence: No counterexample to the actual scalar free-energy coefficients or the actual polynomial asymptotic was computed. The reported defect concerns the written holomorphic-parametrix justification.

proposition.claim:
Recorded check: the critical Tracy–Widom argument

c>0 fixed, real s fixed, n GinUE particles, m=c*n LUE dimension, alpha=1/c. Select an integer subsequence when c*n is required integral. a_n=b-D*s*n^(-2/3)+O(n^(-4/3)), b=sqrt(c+1)-sqrt(c), D=b^(1/3)/(2*c^(1/6)*(c+1)^(1/6)).

Recorded check: the precritical moment prefactor

Fixed strict precritical branch a>b,0<q<1,kappa>0,F(a)=1/q=w>1; exact moment identity(1.8), Euler characteristic1 in free-energy formula(2.6).

Recorded check: an uncancelled pole in the refined parametrix

n=N orthogonal-polynomial degree and asymptotic size; fixed strict precritical a,c; q in(0,1),R,kappa>0. lambda=bar_beta=u-2i*rho,beta=u+2i*rho,u=Rq-kappa/q,rho=sqrt(R*kappa),source branch normalized at infinity.
